name: Data screen
purpose: Operations canvas with KPI tiles and charts that scale to the parent instead of using viewport media queries.
scenarios: Scan four KPI tiles on an operations canvas
Compare traffic and conversion charts in a two-column grid
Fit the 1280×720 design canvas to a smaller parent

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

antiPatterns: Do not size this canvas with viewport width media queries.
Do not claim first-paint performance numbers; Block budgets are unapproved.

keyboard: Tab reaches KPI tiles and chart figures
a11y.focus: Charts expose an accessible name on the SVG.
a11y.labeling: KPI dashboard and both charts have accessible names.

responsive.strategy: A 1280×720 stage scales down with ResizeObserver to fit the parent. Layout is designed at desktop size, then scaled.

breakpoints.compact: Canvas scales down; layout stays the desktop composition.
breakpoints.large: Canvas stays at scale 1 when the parent is at least 1280×720.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
